(Japanese: '''サトシとバタフリー！また会う日まで！！''' ''{{tt|Satoshi|Ash}} and Butterfree! Until the Day We Meet Again!!'') is the 130th episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', and the 787th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on June 13, 2013 and in the United States on September 14, 2013. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Our heroes’ Decolore Island cruise continues, and the next exciting stop on their journey is Wayfarer Island! It’s a beautiful place that serves as a rest stop for all kinds of Pokémon during their migration. Ash, Iris, and Cilan head off to the mountains for some serious Pokémon-watching! Their timing is perfect, and they get to watch a group of Metapod evolve into Butterfree and take wing! But after the Butterfree head off on their migration, a lone Caterpie emerges from the woods. It seems Caterpie wasn’t ready to evolve yet, and now it’s alone. Ash remembers that the first Pokémon he ever caught was a Caterpie, and he’s determined to help this one! But there’s a problem: Caterpie isn’t interested in doing much other than sleeping. Ash reasons that a fully evolved Bug-type Pokémon might be able to help Caterpie evolve, so he sends his Leavanny out to battle it! But when Leavanny’s Energy Ball gives Caterpie a rude awakening, it runs off in a panic. Ash tracks it down and apologizes, and Caterpie decides to trust him. They spend the day climbing trees and playing in the forest. It’s special training, but it’s also fun! And Caterpie even rescues Ash with a well-timed String Shot when he loses his grip and falls. Ash knows that Caterpie has to eat a lot before it can evolve, so he sets out to gather Oran Berries for his new friend. Unfortunately, they’ve wandered into an Ursaring’s territory, and the imposing Pokémon isn’t interested in sharing its Berries! Ash grabs Caterpie and runs, but when they come up against a dead end, Caterpie decides it’s time to battle. It proves itself to be a fierce fighter, driving off the bigger Pokémon before evolving into Metapod! But suddenly they have a deadline—it seems another group of Butterfree will soon leave the island, and if Metapod wants to join them, it needs to evolve again, and fast! Special training kicks into high gear, as Ash puts Metapod through its paces, including a long run that leaves Cilan breathless. And then, their training is rudely interrupted by a new threat that swoops down from above—it’s Team Rocket, showing up yet again to steal Pikachu, and accidentally picking Metapod up in the process! Jessie, James, and Meowth start to fly away in their balloon, but Ash leaps after them and manages to grab onto the side of the basket. As James’s Amoonguss pummels Ash with attacks, Metapod wiggles out of its restraints—and evolves into Butterfree just as Ash is forced to let go! Butterfree catches Ash and puts him down gently on the ground, then goes after the villains and sends them blasting off again! As the sun rises, all the Butterfree get ready to depart, and Ash has to say goodbye to his friend. It’s a bittersweet moment, but Ash promises they’ll meet again someday as Butterfree joins the migration and heads off to a brand-new life! ==Plot== Aboard a ship, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} spot their next [[Decolore Islands]] stop of [[Wayfarer Island]]. Ash sees a flock of {{p|Swanna}} and scans them with his [[Pokédex]]. [[Porter]] explains that the island is a popular spot for migrating Pokémon to rest on their way to other places. Excited to see more migrating Pokémon, the group heads directly for the [[Pokémon Center]]. There, [[Nurse Joy]] tells them that they will find a lot of migrating Pokémon deep in the mountains, and she urges them to stay safe and sound on their adventure. As they walk up towards the mountains, Ash is very excited to see what new Pokémon he can find, which Iris is all too familiar with. Suddenly they run into a patch of {{p|Metapod}}, which Ash scans with his Pokédex. Just as soon as the dex entry is finished, the Metapod start to [[Evolution|evolve]]. Once the {{p|Butterfree}} start to emerge, Ash scans Butterfree with his Pokédex also. {{an|Cilan}} says that this is the first time he has seen a Butterfree while {{an|Iris}} marvels at their beautiful wings. Iris and Ash both notice that the Butterfree are about to begin their migration, and sure enough, they all take off. Ash even notices a second flock of Butterfree flying away from a different location. Everyone is in awe, with Cilan commenting that nature is showing it's delicious recipe for perfection. Suddenly, a {{p|Caterpie}} emerges from the bushes, looking dazed. Ash scans this with his Pokédex also. Since Caterpie is destined to evolve into Metapod and then Butterfree, Iris, and Cilan deduce that it was not able to evolve with the rest and so it's alone. Seeing Caterpie takes Ash back to the Caterpie he himself [[EP003|once caught]], evolved all the way into a {{AP|Butterfree}}, and eventually [[EP021|released]] to live with [[Pink Butterfree|his love]]. Ash and {{AP|Pikachu}} discuss where Caterpie might be now, coming to the conclusion that he's happy with his new life. Ash talks to this Caterpie, trying to get it to evolve, but is frustrated that it's asleep. Suddenly, Ash gets a brainwave and runs back to the Pokémon Center, much to the surprise of Iris and Cilan. At the Center, Ash makes a video call to {{an|Professor Oak}} but is surprised when {{p|Rotom}} answers. Oak scolds Rotom for playing with the videophone, but Rotom electrocutes him in retaliation. After checking that Oak is fine, Ash asks Oak for one of his Pokémon. Ash returns to find Caterpie still sleeping. He nudges it several times and it finally awakes. Ash then tells Caterpie that they should have a [[Pokémon battle]], and calls out fellow {{type|Bug}} {{AP|Leavanny}} to help Caterpie evolve. While Ash is ready to battle, Caterpie, however, falls back asleep. Ash decides to wake up Caterpie by telling Leavanny to use {{m|Energy Ball}}, but this scares Caterpie off. Iris notes that the only thing it's fast at is running away. Even so, Ash is determined to help Caterpie and soon finds it sleeping in a nearby tree. Ash notes that he was ignoring Caterpie's feelings and says he wants to help it evolve and Caterpie agrees. The group takes Caterpie to a shrub of leaves to eat, however, instead of feeling energized, Caterpie falls asleep on a full stomach. Ash is frustrated that Caterpie went back to sleep again and they all decide to take a nap. Later, Caterpie wakes up, also waking Ash in the process. Ash decides it would be good for Caterpie to climb some trees. Caterpie then uses {{m|String Shot}} to glide across the forest. Iris and Ash follow suit using the tree vines. Cilan warns Ash to be careful, but then Ash loses his grip only to be saved by Caterpie's String Shot. Next, they all have some lunch and they eat some {{Berries}} found in the forest. When that is all done, it is sunset, and they decide to head back to the Pokémon Center. Leavanny decides to make Caterpie a leaf hood. The next afternoon, the group finds a forest with a variety of Berries. Caterpie goes to eat some [[Oran Berry|Oran Berries]]. Assuming they must be Caterpie's favorite food, the group decides to gather a bunch of Oran Berries. While picking berries, Ash notices some Pokémon claw marks on the trees and Iris explains that this is how some Pokémon mark their territory. The group soon comes face-to-face with a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Ursaring}} and decides to flee the area. Caterpie, however, was too eating a berry to notice, so Ash leaps in to save it from Ursaring’s attacks. The group hides amongst the bushes, but they are soon spotted after Caterpie suddenly sneezes and shoots some string on Ursaring's back. They run again. But to stop Ursaring, Caterpie emits a strong smell from its antennae, but this only angers Ursaring more. Ursaring chases them to a dead-end cliff. Though Caterpie fights back and uses {{m|Tackle}} and then String Shot to stop Ursaring. Ursaring breaks free of the threads, but Pikachu uses {{m|Thunderbolt}} to defeat Ursaring, causing it to retreat. Iris and Cilan come to Ash's rescue and Ash thanks Caterpie. Suddenly, Caterpie evolves into Metapod and falls asleep. That night, Iris informs Ash that another entire flock of Butterfree is approaching Wayfarer Island next week. Cilan tells Ash that if evolves it can go with them. Ash isn't sure because of how often Metapod sleeps. Metapod suddenly wakes up but is quick to refuse Ash’s suggestion that they work hard tomorrow. The next morning, the group decides to go for a run and Metapod looks very determined. But above them, there is a flock of Butterfree and Ash notices that they are a week early, with Iris commenting that they must have got a strong tailwind. Cilan says that the Butterfree will leave the next day when the sun comes up, and Ash notices that Metapod is sleeping during this conversation. Ash tells Metapod that it needs special training so Ash decides to do hurdles, the horseback, push-ups, and more running. This wasn't enough and after all this training Metapod still hasn't evolved. Suddenly, {{TRT}} comes out of nowhere, only to snatch both Pikachu and Metapod. They quickly trap Pikachu in an electric-proof capsule but are unimpressed with their bonus capture of Metapod. Ash tries to chase them and manages to grab onto their balloon, so [[James]] has his {{TP|James|Amoonguss}} use {{m|Body Slam}} to knock the [[twerp]] down. Before Team Rocket can succeed in their evil scheme, Metapod evolves into Butterfree and uses {{m|Confusion}} to help Ash to the ground safely. This makes [[Jessie]] angry and she sends out {{TP|Jessie|Woobat}} to combine his {{m|Air Slash}} with Amoonguss's {{m|Hidden Power}}. Though Butterfree dodges both and frees Pikachu from the capsule with {{m|Psybeam}}. Before Jessie, James, and {{MTR}} can make one final attempt to succeed, their plan is thwarted as Ash commands Pikachu and Butterfree to combine both Psybeam and Thunderbolt to finish them for good, destroying their balloon and sending Team Rocket blasting off. Now with the morning sun shining through, the Butterfree emerge from their slumber and prepare to continue their migration. Ash reminds his friend Butterfree that it is time to go, and while reluctant, it joins the others in flight. As the group bids their farewells to Butterfree, Ash gets upset that a second Butterfree leaves him. He tells Butterfree that it will do just fine and tells it not to nap otherwise it will lose the others. Iris asks whether Ash is crying, but he makes the excuse that it is a happy moment. Coincidentally, the last time this happened was in ''[[AG142|Caterpie's Big Dilemma]]'', 371 episodes earlier; the evolving Pokémon in this case was also a {{p|Caterpie}}. * This is the only episode during Ash's travels through the [[Decolore Islands]] where he is seen rotating his Pokémon to and from his active [[party]]. ** This is also the last time that Ash is seen rotating his team until ''[[JN137|The Road Most Traveled!]]'', 435 episodes later. ===Errors=== * During several scenes throughout the episode, Ash's eyes are colored black instead of brown. * When Ash and {{ashfr}} witness the Evolution of the {{p|Metapod}} swarm, Ash says that he has never before seen this many Metapod evolving at the same time, even though he has already witnessed a mass Evolution of Metapod in ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''. * In one shot of Ash and his friends helping Caterpie, Caterpie's tail is colored green instead of yellow. * When Ash is reading a magazine in the [[Pokémon Center]], Pikachu's cheek pouch is colored pink instead of red. * In the closeup of Ash and {{p|Metapod}} running to the cliff at night, Metapod is cut off several times. * During the brief scene showing {{TRT}} after their {{motto}}, the [[Team Rocket's mechas|Meowth balloon]]'s ears are cream-colored like its face, instead of black. * In one scene, one of the video screens on the control panel of Team Rocket's balloon disappears. * When Team Rocket is [[Blasting off|blasted off]], {{TP|Jessie|Woobat}} and {{TP|James|Amoonguss}} disappear.
